components.name: DLSS-Enabler
components.notes: The repository demonstrates application-level interception and external upscaler orchestration. No upstream executable or proprietary NVIDIA binary is bundled by ISB.

components.name: OptiScaler
components.notes: Pinned to an immutable commit. ISB may detect/configure/validate an installed OptiScaler. OptiScaler source is not linked into ISB core by this component manifest.

components.name: fakenvapi
components.notes: The snapshot is not part of the ISB build. It is retained to guide the future Windows/application low-latency compatibility implementation.

components.name: Mesa
components.notes: Pinned to an immutable reference revision. Mesa architecture informs layered graphics boundaries. Individual files must still be audited by SPDX identifier before source import.

components.name: NVIDIA Open GPU Kernel Modules
components.notes: Pinned to the 615.71.09 source revision. Used for OS-agnostic versus platform-specific architecture. The current upstream target hardware does not provide a V100/GV100 backend.
